descriptions.text: Bitcoinica was hacked twice in 2012. Hackers stole a total of 61,000 BTC, leading to the bankruptcy of Bitcoinica.

Bitcoinica lost 18,547 BTC (≈$90,000) on May 11, 2012 after attackers compromised an admin email account, enabling hot wallet access on Bitcoin. Customer data including emails was exposed, creating phishing risks. A partial (50%) repayment policy was announced, but full restitution was never completed. Attackers gained privileged access to a compromised team member's email server, allowing control over wallet and backend infrastructure. The hot wallet was insufficiently segregated from admin email, enabling direct withdrawal of funds. User database information including emails was also exposed.
